items.text: Detroit: S Kerby Joseph (knee) OUT. DNP - LB Jack Campbell (neck; hospitalized after Week 8 backboard injury), C Cade Mays (ankle), CB D.J. Reed (hip), DE DJ Wonnum (concussion); limited - WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib), S Brian Branch, RB Jacob Saylors (neck). On IR: RB Isiah Pacheco, LB Devin White, G Ben Bartch.

Miami: RB Jaylen Wright DNP; limited - DT Zach Sieler, EDGE Chop Robinson, EDGE Malik Herring, S Michael Taaffe, S Dante Trader Jr., RB Kaytron Allen. RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for season. Malik Willis starts.
